violations.text: Pancake batter was observed held on the counter at 65 degrees Fahrenheit; double-stacked sausage was observed held at 54 degrees in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Staff placed batter on ice; sausage was unstacked. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -sauce bottles -reach-in freezer shelves (ice build-up) -server low boy (water). New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The following was observed in poor repair: -coving damaged/missing behind kitchen prep unit -ceiling molding in storage (trailer area) detaching from wall. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026

Baked beans and hollandaise sauce was observed held between 51-56 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed in walk-in cooler for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview, hollandaise sauce was placed hot in the 2 door refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. PIC pour hollandaise in shallower containers and placed them in the walk-in cooler. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2025

The presence of small flies is not controlled as evidenced by live small flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2025

Various items were observed held between 46-53 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed of. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2025
Inspector observed sausage, pasta salad, and chowder past the 7 day date marking. PIC discarded items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Baked potatoes (foil removed) were placed hot in the freezer in containers greater than four inches deep. PIC placed in shallower containers. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2025

The presence of small flies are not controlled as evidenced by live small flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2025

The hand-washing sink in the dish-washing area was blocked by fan and had items in the sink. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC moved fan over and removed items from sink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took unit out of service to be washed and sanitized. PIC disposed of ice. PIC sent staff to purchase ice in meantime. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Batter was observed held at 52 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed in cooler unit for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC wrote the names during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Hollandaise sauce was observed cooling on the counter in containers deeper than 4 inches. PIC moved the sauce to a 2 inch pan and placed in the walk-in cooler. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Working containers of ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2025

The presence of small flies are not controlled as evidenced by live flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Rubber spatula was observed stored on old egg cartons. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. PIC washed/sanitized rubber spatula and discarded egg cartons. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Utensils (cutlery) in the back service station are displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris: -prep units, -table/shelves under flat top grill, -shelf above flat top grill New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025
Inspector observed outside grease receptacle with an heavy accumulation of grease and other debris on the outside. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024

Sausages observed held at 95 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Sausages were reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2024

French toast batter observed held at 70 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2024

Plastic food containers observed stored on unclean cardboard next to the hand sink in the expo area. One ice bucket observed stored in an unclean sink with a pool of water. One ice bucket observed stored on an unclean surface, inverted on a chair. Equipment and utensils shall be stored in a clean dry location, where they are not subject to dust, splash, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2024
One ice bucket was observed not stored inverted, with water in it. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2024

The floors and walls throughout the kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2024
The hand-washing sink in the back bar was lacking proper signage. New Violation. Correct By: 06/14/2024

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024

Pooled eggs, batter, and cheese observed observed held at 48-53 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Items were placed in freezer to rapidly chill, and staff instructed on proper cold holding using ice. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024
Chicken and oatmeal observed marked with dates exceeding 7 days. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024
Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024

Thermometers are lacking in several refrigeration units. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024

Cucumber and avacado were not washed before being cut. Raw fruits and vegetables must be thoroughly washed in water to remove soil and other contaminants before they are cut. Avacado was disposed of. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024
Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the front bar area. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024

Single service items observed stored on the floor in the back storage area. Single service items must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/14/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the back bar have an accumulation of soil residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/20/2024
Hand washing sinks have an accumulation of soil residue and debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024
The FRP in the expo area is in poor repair, pulling away from the wall. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/20/2024
